text:
Alex: heads-up — legal asked whether we can show a timeline for privileged changes (routing policies, quota overrides, dedicated capacity changes) in Console + export them to the compliance store.
Maria: +1, they want clear "who changed what, when, why" and a machine-friendly export for audits.
Sam: high-level Q — do we want a single event shape for all change types or specialized shapes per resource? e.g. route vs quota vs rollout.
Bryce (PM): single canonical event with typed payload seems easier for querying, but UI needs structured diffs to render nice human-friendly changes.
Alex: idea: canonical envelope + resource-specific diff blob. envelope fields: actor_id, actor_email, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, ts, reason, request_id.
compliance-bot: suggested retention: 7 years for privileged events; mark PII if actor email present and redact on export if required by tenant policy.
Tay: concern — diffs for routing policies can be huge (thousands of routes) and blow up streaming exports. need sampling or change-summary.
Sam: we should store both a compact diff (summary of keys changed) and optional full JSON snapshot when change size < 10KB. larger ones get a compressed snapshot reference.
Alex: propose event shape snippet for review:

```
{
  "actor_id":"u_123",
  "actor_email":"alex@redwood.ai",
  "action":"update",
  "resource_type":"routing_policy",
  "resource_id":"policy_98",
  "ts":"2026-03-18T15:02:12Z",
  "reason":"override for incident",
  "diff_summary":["route.add:3","route.remove:1","weight.change:2"],
  "full_diff_url":"s3://compliance-exports/....",
  "request_id":"r_987"
}
```

Bryce (PM): UX ask — in Console timeline show a 1-line summary + expand to full before/after diff with inline highlights; allow CSV/NDJSON export scoped to time range + actor filter.
Ops Lead: operationally we need immutability guarantees. once event committed it must be append-only and signed by infra (HMAC or KMS). Also need a simple replay API for legal.
Sam: signing with KMS OK, but HSM/KMS calls add latency during write — we can batch-sign commits asynchronously and mark provisional until signed? risk for compliance.
Alex: provisional state is messy for audits. better to sync-sign for privileged categories only (policy changes, role grants) and async for low-risk telemetry.
Maria: does anyone have thoughts about linking change events to rollouts? e.g., a policy change that was rolled out via canary should reference rollout_id and include rollout deltas.
Tay: yes include rollout_id and stage metadata. that way you can correlate anomalies in metrics to a specific config change.
Eng Docs: small doc suggestion — include examples of common queries in the export schema doc: actor->resource history, resource->who touches it, time-range exports. Also show sample Kibana/KQL queries.
Bryce (PM): compliance asked about schema evolution. we must support versioned event schema and parser helpers in SDKs.
Alex: agreed — add top-level schema_version and keep old parsers for back-compat in exports.
Maria: final-ish ask from legal: ability to mask actor_email on tenant request and still keep actor_id (pseudonymous) for SSO audits.
Sam: implementable: store actor_id separate, redact email on export, keep mapping in secure lookup with tighter ACL.
Ops Lead: note on retention: make retention configurable per org with max cap 10 years and default 7y. enforce deletions via background job that emits deletion events.
compliance-bot: FYI — a deletion event itself is privileged and must be recorded (who deleted, reason, policy referencing).
Alex: next steps — Sam/Tay to sketch event schema + perf implications; Maria/Bryce to prototype timeline UX with expand/collapse + export button; Eng Docs to draft export examples. sync Fri 11am?
Sam: I'll have a first-pass schema and perf numbers by Thu EOD.
Tay: I'll prototype storage layout options and size estimates.
Bryce (PM): adding calendar invite for Fri 11am. thanks all :thumbsup!
